title: Beautiful, Historic Guesthouse, 566
description:
This unique and stylish guesthouse sits on the historic property of the FitzGerald Manor (now known as South Water Manor). Positioned near the heart of Gallatin, Tennessee, this beautifully restored guesthouse was once a summer kitchen for the staff of the manor. While preserving the history and the architectural details, the building has been renovated to a very high standard, with every effort to couple the stories of yesterday with the conveniences and luxuries of today.

Guest access
You have access to your rented building (#566) as well as the outdoor pergola area. Bistro 562 & Coffee House, which is inside of South Water Manor (just steps away) is open for breakfast and lunch, Tuesday-Saturday!
